CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit
Private m_Canceling As Boolean
' ============================================================================
'  frmProviderServiceCatalogDetail
' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
'  Popup detail form for a single tblProviderServiceCatalog row.
'  Opened acDialog from frmProviderDetail.lstProviderServiceCatalog.
'
'  RecordSource:  tblProviderServiceCatalog
'  PopUp:         True
'  Modal:         True            (caller also passes acDialog)
'  BorderStyle:   3  (Dialog)
'
'  OpenArgs convention:
'     "ADD|ProviderID=123|FiscalYear=2025"   ? Add mode with parent context
'     "<numericID>"                          ? Edit mode for that ID
'
'  Controls:
'     ProviderServiceCatalogID   (PK, hidden)
'     cboProviderID              (FK to tblProviders; locked in Add mode
'                                 because the context already supplies it)
'     cboServiceID               (FK to tblServices)
'     FiscalYear                 (locked ? set from context in Add mode)
'     RatePerHour                (Currency, > 0)
'     Notes                      (memo)
'     btnSave / btnCancel / btnDelete
' ============================================================================
Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
    Dim args As Variant
    args = Me.OpenArgs
    If basListHelpers.IsAddMode(args) Then
        Me.DataEntry = True
    ElseIf IsNumeric(Nz(args, "")) Then
        Me.Filter = "ProviderServiceCatalogID=" & CLng(args)
        Me.FilterOn = True
    End If
End Sub
Private Sub Form_Load()
    ' Populate the two combos. They have no stored row source (per the
    ' design view) ? set them here so they're always in sync with what
    ' the form needs.
    Me.cboProviderID.RowSource = _
        "SELECT ProviderID, ProviderName FROM tblProviders " & _
        "ORDER BY ProviderName"
    Me.cboProviderID.ColumnCount = 2
    Me.cboProviderID.ColumnWidths = "0;2.5 in"
    Me.cboProviderID.BoundColumn = 1
    Me.cboServiceID.RowSource = _
        "SELECT ServiceID, ServiceName FROM tblServices " & _
        "WHERE IsActive=True ORDER BY ServiceName"
    Me.cboServiceID.ColumnCount = 2
    Me.cboServiceID.ColumnWidths = "0;2.5 in"
    Me.cboServiceID.BoundColumn = 1
    If basListHelpers.IsAddMode(Me.OpenArgs) Then
        Dim ProviderID As Long, fy As Long
        ProviderID = basListHelpers.GetContextLong(Me.OpenArgs, "ProviderID")
        fy = basListHelpers.GetContextLong(Me.OpenArgs, "FiscalYear")
        If ProviderID > 0 Then Me!ProviderID = ProviderID
        If fy > 0 Then Me!FiscalYear = fy
        Me.btnDelete.Enabled = False
        Me.Caption = "New Provider Service Catalog Entry"
    Else
        Me.btnDelete.Enabled = True
        Me.Caption = "Edit Provider Service Catalog Entry"
    End If
    ' FY and Provider are part of the row's identity in this scope ? the
    ' user opened this dialog to edit ONE provider's offering for ONE FY.
    ' Lock both, plus FY in either mode.
    Me.cboProviderID.Locked = True
    Me.FiscalYear.Locked = True
End Sub
' ============================================================================
'  Validation
' ============================================================================
Private Sub Form_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
    If m_Canceling Then Exit Sub
    If IsNull(Me!ProviderID) Then
        MsgBox "Provider is required.", vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If IsNull(Me!ServiceID) Then
        MsgBox "Please select a service.", vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Me.cboServiceID.SetFocus
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If IsNull(Me!FiscalYear) Then
        MsgBox "Fiscal year is required.", vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If IsNull(Me!RatePerHour) Or Me!RatePerHour <= 0 Then
        MsgBox "Rate per hour must be greater than zero.", _
               vbExclamation, "Validation"
        Me.RatePerHour.SetFocus
        Cancel = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    ' Cap check against tblServiceRateLimits for this (ServiceID, FiscalYear).
    ' Permissive: missing rate-limit row means no cap. The data macro on
    ' tblProviderServiceCatalog enforces the same rule with the same policy.
    Dim maxRate As Variant
    maxRate = DLookup("MaxRatePerHour", "tblServiceRateLimits", _
                      "ServiceID=" & Me!ServiceID & _
                      " AND FiscalYear=" & Me!FiscalYear)
    If Not IsNull(maxRate) Then
        If Me!RatePerHour > maxRate Then
            MsgBox "Rate of " & Format(Me!RatePerHour, "Currency") & _
                   " exceeds the FY" & Me!FiscalYear & " maximum of " & _
                   Format(maxRate, "Currency") & " for this service.", _
                   vbExclamation, "Rate Exceeds Limit"
            Me.RatePerHour.SetFocus
            Cancel = True
            Exit Sub
        End If
    End If
    ' Duplicate check: same provider + service + FY (any other row).
    Dim selfID As Long
    selfID = Nz(Me!ProviderServiceCatalogID, 0)
    If DCount("*", "tblProviderServiceCatalog", _
              "ProviderID=" & Me!ProviderID & _
              " AND ServiceID=" & Me!ServiceID & _
              " AND FiscalYear=" & Me!FiscalYear & _
              " AND ProviderServiceCatalogID<>" & selfID) > 0 Then
        MsgBox "This provider already has a catalog entry for this service " & _
               "in FY" & Me!FiscalYear & ".", vbExclamation, "Duplicate"
        Cancel = True
    End If
End Sub
' Heads-up message while the rate field is still focused, before save.
' BeforeUpdate is the authoritative check; this is a UX nicety.
Private Sub RatePerHour_AfterUpdate()
    If IsNull(Me!ServiceID) Or IsNull(Me!FiscalYear) Or IsNull(Me!RatePerHour) Then Exit Sub
    Dim maxRate As Variant
    maxRate = DLookup("MaxRatePerHour", "tblServiceRateLimits", _
                      "ServiceID=" & Me!ServiceID & _
                      " AND FiscalYear=" & Me!FiscalYear)
    If Not IsNull(maxRate) And Me!RatePerHour > maxRate Then
        MsgBox "Heads-up: this exceeds the FY" & Me!FiscalYear & _
               " cap of " & Format(maxRate, "Currency") & _
               " for this service.", vbInformation, "Above Cap"
    End If
End Sub
' ============================================================================
'  Action buttons
' ============================================================================
Private Sub btnSave_Click()
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If Me.Dirty Then Me.Dirty = False    ' fires Form_BeforeUpdate
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.name
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    ' Validation canceled the save ? leave the dialog open.
End Sub
Private Sub btnCancel_Click()
    m_Canceling = True
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.name, acSaveNo
End Sub
Private Sub btnDelete_Click()
    If Me.NewRecord Then Exit Sub
    ' Block delete if any tblClientServicePlan row references this catalog row.
    Dim inUse As Long
    inUse = DCount("*", "tblClientServicePlan", _
                   "ProviderServiceCatalogID=" & Me!ProviderServiceCatalogID)
    If inUse > 0 Then
        MsgBox "Cannot delete this catalog entry." & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
               inUse & " client service plan row(s) reference it. " & _
               "Remove or reassign those plans first.", _
               vbExclamation, "Catalog Entry In Use"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If MsgBox("Delete this catalog entry?", _
              vbYesNo + vbQuestion + vbDefaultButton2, _
              "Confirm Delete") = vbNo Then Exit Sub
    On Error GoTo Failed
    RunCommand acCmdSelectRecord
    RunCommand acCmdDeleteRecord
    DoCmd.Close acForm, Me.name
    Exit Sub
Failed:
    MsgBox "Could not delete: " & Err.Description, vbCritical, "Delete Failed"
End Sub
' ============================================================================
'  Combo niceties
' ============================================================================
Private Sub cboServiceID_NotInList(NewData As String, Response As Integer)
    Response = acDataErrContinue
    MsgBox "To add a new service, use the Service List form.", _
           vbInformation, "Add Service Elsewhere"
End Sub
